Mat’s flown over to Dubai, and he’s about to go on a tour of a Mansory dealership! 

Mansory is one of the most famous names in car modifications, and he’s about to be taken on a tour of the many different cars that Mansory has worked on. 

Now before the tour, you have to consider two words that spring to mind when you think of crazy car mods - carbon fibre! And at this dealership, the amount of carbon fibre used is a true sight to be seen! Almost every car comes with a huge amount of carbon fibre added to it. Whether it’s the exterior or interior, carbon fibre is a key component of almost every car on sale at this dealership.

And in terms of the stock, it’s a who’s who of some of the most famous performance car names in the world. From Ferrari to AMG and Lamborghini, Mansory is willing to go to town on any car it can get its hands on. There’s even a certain all-electric American pick-up truck on show, if
title: Mansory tried to PROVE ME WRONG!
